66f51f3a0000000000000b02 description: Mechanic says you can be relied on. Good. I can put together a TSC handset, but I need something to build it from. Bring me one Broken GPhone smartphone, one set of Electronic components, and a Screwdriver. Used or bought makes no difference. Hand over those three things and this job is finished. I will assemble the handset here while we sort out the network.
66f51f3a0000000000000b02 startedMessageT: One Broken GPhone, one set of Electronic components, and one Screwdriver. That is all I need for the assembly.
66f51f3a0000000000000b02 successMessageT: That is everything. I can work with this. The handset will stay with me until we have a reliable signal for pairing. Come back for the radio job; once that connection is working, the TSC is yours.
66f51f3a0000000000000b02 failMessageText: The work is still waiting. Come back when you are ready.
66f51f3a0000000000000b02 declinePlayerMe: I'll come back when I'm ready.
66f51f3a000000000000c202: Hand over 1 Broken GPhone smartphone to Pilot
66f51f3a000000000000c203: Hand over 1 Electronic components to Pilot
66f51f3a0000000000000b03 description: The handset is assembled. Now we need a reliable link to get it online. Take this Radio repeater to the antenna at the weather station on Shoreline. Install it at the antenna's base and give it forty seconds to establish the connection. Then survive and extract from Shoreline and report back. I will pair your handset and hand it over. If you lose the repeater before installation, replacements are available from my shop for 20,000 roubles. A completed installation stays done; if you do not make it out afterward, survive a later Shoreline raid.
66f51f3a0000000000000b03 startedMessageT: The repeater is ready to collect. Install it at the weather-station antenna on Shoreline, then survive and extract. Keep the handset job in mind: the connection comes first.
66f51f3a0000000000000b03 successMessageT: Signal is stable and your handset is paired. Here is your TerraGroup TSC Uplink, along with payment for the work. Replacements are available from my shop for 50,000 roubles. You can now purchase and request the available support packages. Service prices and authorization limits still apply.
66f51f3a0000000000000b03 failMessageText: The work is still waiting. Come back when you are ready.
66f51f3a0000000000000b03 declinePlayerMe: I'll come back when I'm ready.
66f51f3a000000000000c302: Install a Radio repeater at the weather-station antenna on Shoreline
66f51f3a000000000000c303: Survive and extract from Shoreline after installing the repeater
